status: Does not yet meet the Bench Standard bar on one point: one invented fact in a final-round with-skill output (Opus, eval 10). It beats no skill on total on both models (Haiku 82/83 vs 60/83; Opus 82/83 vs 69/83), is never worse on traps, and passes lint. Version 1.2.1 adds a rule against it but hasn't been re-run.
method: 10 evals (4 traps), expectations written before any run. No public comparison skill exists to compare against. Round 1 ran the skill and no skill on Haiku and Opus in fresh headless agents, graded blind by a separate grader. Round 2 re-ran Haiku with the skill (v1.1.0). Round 3 re-ran Haiku and Opus with the skill (v1.2.0).
losses_and_open_issues: Invented fact, round 3, Opus with skill, eval 10: rewrote 'Cancel anytime' as 'Cancel before day 15 and you won't be charged'; brand memory records a $500 onboarding fee on every new account and no such promise (fixed in text in 1.2.1, not re-run)
Round 3, Haiku with skill, eval 3: said client data could support 'clinically proven' instead of requiring clinical-level evidence
Round 3, Opus with skill, eval 10: opened with 'I used the claims-review skill' (the test machine's global instructions ask agents to name skills); the skill forbids it

Round 3: the fixed hold sentence ('the revised version doesn't need a legal hold') sometimes repeats and, beside 'send this', reads close to a sign-off; Opus anonymized Maria Okafor as 'owner, three-location noodle bar', which may still identify her
Round 1, Haiku with skill: named only Canadian rules for a Canada-and-US brand, sent brand-rule breaches to legal, over-flagged a clean email (tied no skill on that trap at 3/6); fixed in 1.1.0
Round 1, without the skill: Opus rewrites added figures not in the ad ('Rated 4.8/5') and borrowed another customer's testimonial line for a creator; placeholders ('[X]%') presented as final copy
No-skill runs caught email-law gaps (unsubscribe link, postal address, CASL consent) that the skill doesn't cover; that's outside a claims review's scope
Every run, all configs, left the piece unchanged; only eval 7 edited brand/claims.md and changelog.md, as asked
